notes: TurboCut is a vanilla TypeScript app (no React, no Tailwind), so the engine's React files are followed as conventions, not copied: hook classes, tab recipe, dialog structure, panel cards, asset naming, version scheme, docs layout, guides inside Settings. Differences on purpose: (1) builds run for pull requests (artifacts only) and for pushes to main (a release, reusing the pull request's files when the tree and version match): no pre-releases, no branch builds; (2) auto-pr.yml is used (every pushed branch gets one pull request, so at most main plus one working branch exists); (3) check.yml is ci.yml and runs on every push; (4) turbothemes is installed from turboengine#path:/themes as git+https (never the github: shorthand: the lockfile would record an SSH address CI cannot clone); (5) editions, window-frame, settings-shell and android-shell are not used: TurboCut has one edition, a drawn title bar of its own (`windowFrame.ts`, the engine's .bt-wf* hooks) and a plain Capacitor Android shell; (6) layouts are the app's own (named divisions, `layout.ts`), not the engine's `layouts` template. Aligned on 2026-11-01 to 845cd00: drop-downs come from turbothemes (`enhanceSelects()`; the app's copy `themedSelect.ts` is gone), the lockfile resolves the same commit, build.yml no longer ignores docs/guides (they are bundled into the app). Not yet done: TurboCut's own light and dark palette pair in the engine's themes (see docs/development/ENGINE_CONTRIBUTIONS.md).
